# vngcloud_vdb_kafka_config_group (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vngcloud_vdb_kafka_config_group" "kafka_config" {
  name        = "tf-kafka-config"
  description = "Kafka configuration group managed by Terraform"
  properties  = {
    "default.replication.factor" = "3"
    "num.io.threads"             = "8"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- **name** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The name of the configuration group. This is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **description** (String, Optional, ForceNew):
    - An optional description for the configuration group. Defaults to an empty string. This field cannot be changed after creation.

- **properties** (Map, Required):
    - A map of parameters to be applied to the configuration group. The keys and values must be strings. Updating this field creates a new version of the configuration group.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to all arguments above, the following attributes are exported:
- **id** (String) The ID of this configuration group.

- **status** (String, Computed):
    - The current status of the configuration group.

- **portal_user_id** (Int, Computed):
    - The portal user ID that owns the configuration group.

- **created_at** (String, Computed):
    - The time when the configuration group was created.

- **current_version_id** (String, Computed):
    - The ID of the latest version of the configuration group.

- **current_version** (Int, Computed):
    - The version number of the latest version of the configuration group.

- **versions** (List, Computed):
    - The list of historical versions for this configuration group. Each version contains:
        - **id** (String, Computed): The ID of the version.
        - **version** (Int, Computed): The version number.
        - **created_at** (String, Computed): The time when the version was created.
